quote: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stop such vehicle upon any street at any place for the purpose of loading or unloading passengers or their baggage other than at a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or the origin or destination point for the route to which such vehicle is assigned which has been designated in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010], except in case of an emergency.

activation.source_clause: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus
activation.description: Identify the bus and actual class from original records.

obligation.source_clause: Not stop such vehicle upon any street at any place for the purpose of loading or unloading passengers or their baggage
obligation.description: Join a stopped bus to actual loading and the precise original place.

exceptions.source_clause: except in case of an emergency
exceptions.description: Preserve the emergency exception as a separate original-facts review.

timing.source_clause: for the purpose of loading or unloading passengers or their baggage
timing.description: Join loading evidence to the stopped interval using original frame times.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original class or permit record must identify excluded tour buses.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: for the purpose of loading or unloading passengers or their baggage
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original door, passenger and baggage evidence must establish actual loading purpose.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: which has been designated in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010]
judgment_calls_needed.note: A designation authority record for the assigned route endpoint is not supplied.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: except in case of an emergency
judgment_calls_needed.note: Emergency facts require independent original review.
